name: Sev
description: Fried besan noodles, fine or thick — the crunch on every chaat.

ayurveda.note: Ushna in a high degree — fried besan with chilli.

histamine.note: Fried and stored for weeks; the oil ages more than the besan does.

guna.note: Fresh and simple — the sattvic default for plant food eaten close to how it grew.
